title: What worked for me building a game with Midjourney + Claude Code (3 tips)
author: Infinite-One-9078
selftext:
Hi all,

I’ve been working on a mobile game for several months, using AI for both code and visuals. Blocks fall into a dungeon and your heroes fight on their own.

[https://madmanu77.itch.io/falltasy](https://madmanu77.itch.io/falltasy)  
(free, plays in the browser, no install)

A few tips that worked for me:

* **Midjourney:** I reuse one `--sref` code for every background, so all 6 chapters share the same style.
* **Sprites:** I generate characters on a flat background, then remove it with a small Python script. The settings have to be tuned *per character* (one global filter ate the colors of another hero).
* **Claude Code:** I keep a test suite (Vitest + Playwright screenshots) so the AI can refactor big files without breaking the game.

Happy to answer any questions!

comments.author: Disastrous-Round-150
comments.body: I gave you a upvote just for using Midjourney in game dev! I love MJ! 😂

replies.author: Infinite-One-9078
replies.body:
Midjourney is great for visuals. It has really empowered my creativity. I give it some hints on prompts then get results then select the better one then ask little or various variation.

Hint is about references:

\- MAIN MAJOR RULE : all my prompts to midjourney are generates by Claude Code. It has a whole understanding over my project and know how midjourny works.

\-  the "sref" tag of midjourney is mandatory to get alignement over all yours creations.

\- for a variation (for example the same character when attacking): then use the omni reference with 80%.

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: for the screenshot tests i would keep a few fixed game states, including a crowded fight and a small phone screen. the same enemies and positions each time would make changes easier to spot. i would also check one real action, like whether a hero can still hit the enemy after the refactor. a screenshot can look right while the combat is broken, and a test can pass while a button is hidden behind something else

replies.author: Infinite-One-9078
replies.body: Indeed. And you speak about refactor, that's a good point!!! Each week I ask Claude to refactor the game to improve the efficiancy of the code.
